recon_enumeration: Atlas is Drupal. Same-origin /geoserver/web/, WMS/WFS capabilities, ArcGIS services/admin/manager, and /api probes returned 404; no GeoServer version was exposed, so no CVE-2024-36401 version comparison was applicable.
Atlas /kaarten embeds https://atlas.apps.geodan.nl/map/. It is a third-party/off-scope host and was recorded without being requested.

Monumentenregister is Drupal. GET search is a Drupal Views (register-of-monuments) HTML search at /monumentenregister?tekst=/?query=; the harmless marker was encoded/partial (not raw) and a benign real-term search returned HTML result cards, not a JSON API. The public record identifier is Monumentnummer (a public number, ineligible as IDOR on its own); result detail cards render below the 1 MiB capture cap so the exact detail-URL path was not retained. /api, /api/v1, and /jsonapi returned 404.
jenvconnect.nl exposed Ruby on Rails CSRF metadata/TinyMCE Rails integration; sitemap, login, and search-marker checks returned 403.

www.rivm.nl and lci.rivm.nl are Drupal; anonymous /jsonapi returned resource-type indexes only. No resource collection was queried. www.rivm.nl HTTP root 301-redirected to HTTPS (CSV https=nee was an Internet.nl quirk, not a missing-HTTPS finding).
www.rvig.nl is Drupal; /api and /jsonapi returned 404. Search-marker output was encoded/partial.

exploit_foothold.result: None. No GeoServer CVE payload, layer/filter/bbox mutation, ArcGIS object enumeration, authentication, POST/write, or ID enumeration was performed.

failed_attempts_constraints: The actual Atlas map application is on off-scope atlas.apps.geodan.nl, preventing authorized inspection of its backend in this wave.
The Monumentenregister primary landing form is Drupal POST and was not submitted; the separate GET filter form was used for the marker check and one benign real-term search only.
Status-only 403/404 observations do not establish absence of authenticated or third-party-backed vulnerabilities.
Three response bodies (monument root, monument real-term search, two jenvconnect JS bundles) hit the 1 MiB capture cap; content beyond the cap was intentionally not retained.
unexplored_surface: atlas.apps.geodan.nl and any related tiles/CDN/API hosts require separate scope authorization.
Authenticated flows, registration, POST forms, record-ID enumeration, non-public fields, and writes remain deliberately untested.
RIVM/LCI JSON:API resource collections were not queried because the index did not provide a concrete non-public-data hypothesis.
cultureelerfgoed.nl sibling subdomains (beeldbank/catalogus) are out of this wave's scope and were only recorded.
considerations_for_next_agent: Do not repeat these 55 GETs. If atlas.apps.geodan.nl is separately authorized, start from the saved /kaarten embed and preserve the same GET-only, one-second, 1 MiB, and immediate vulnerable-GeoServer stop rules. Treat encoded marker reflection and public Monumentnummer identifiers as non-findings absent executable/non-public-data impact.

compliance.budgets: 55/70 global; Atlas 13/20; Monumentenregister 10/10; each other host 8/10
compliance.prohibited_activity: No exploit, DoS, brute force, social engineering, malware, write, authentication attempt, map enumeration, or out-of-scope request
